integrity: The proof uses the DPham survival and mass functions printed in the primary 2026 source. All infinite-domain statements are analytic; the included numerical script is only a consistency check. The inaccessible continuous-Pham full text is recorded as a residual originality risk rather than treated as negative evidence.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns asymptotic tail class and does not assess finite-sample goodness of fit.
For small alpha or mu near one, convergence to the asymptotic regime can be slow on practically observed ranges.
The closest broad study of the continuous Pham distribution was available only at abstract level during comparison.
title: The DPham tail is lighter than every geometric tail
